Analysts remained positive on the online retailer's “market share gains, strategic growth initiatives, expanding profitability, & capital return profile,” but said the industry backdrop warranted a more cautious valuation.

The new target is based on roughly seven times JPMorgan’s 2028 adjusted EBITDA estimate of $1.2 billion. Potential upside includes stronger consumer demand, faster share gains and greater AI-driven margin expansion.
